xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:RelatedPartyTransactionExplana: Notes: 1. Loans given and returned within the reporting period have not been reported 2. Opening and closing balance are not given where there was no transaction of Investment during the half year ended March 31, 2025 3. Foreign Currency transactions are converted at an average rate of exchange during the period. Foreign currency opening and closing balances are convered at a rate of exchanges as at the respective closing date. 4. The interest rates of loan are as applicable as on March 31, 2025 5. Approval granted by the Audit Committee in foreign currency are shown in INR basis the exchange rate as on March 31, 2025 6. In case of Rental Transactions, the approved limit is the amount of rent approved for the FY 24-25 7. Transactions with the employees of the Parent Company who are appointed as Directors / KMPs on it's subsidiary companies have not been disclosed considering that such transactions are in accordance with their terms of employment. 8. Post employment benefits are actuarially determined on overall basis and hence not separately provided. 9. The Company on 03rd March, 2025 had acquired 100% equity stake in Kalpataru Power DMCC, erstwhile step-down wholly owned subsidiary from Kalpataru Power Transmission (Mauritius) Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company. Consequent thereto, Kalpataru Power DMCC has become a direct wholly owned subsidiary of the Company with effect from the said date. 10. During the current financial year, Adeshwar Infrabuild Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary has been struck off from the register of the companies and the said Company is dissolved with effect from 28th December, 2024.
